evals.prompt: 새 Node.js 프로젝트에 release-it을 설정해줘. GitHub Release를 자동 생성하고, conventional-changelog로 CHANGELOG.md를 관리하고, main 브랜치에서만 릴리스할 수 있게 해줘. CI에서 사용할 GitHub Actions 워크플로우도 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: .release-it.json (or equivalent) with git.requireBranch=main, github.release=true, @release-it/conventional-changelog plugin config, and a GitHub Actions workflow YAML file

assertions.text: A release-it config file exists in outputs
Config has github.release set to true
Config has git.requireBranch set to 'main'
Config includes @release-it/conventional-changelog plugin with preset and infile
A GitHub Actions workflow YAML file exists with release-it --ci command
GitHub Actions supplies the credentials required for the requested capabilities; NPM_TOKEN is not required when npm publishing is disabled or uses trusted publishing.
GitHub Actions checkout uses fetch-depth: 0
Config includes $schema URL for IDE autocomplete

evals.expected_output: Updated .release-it.json with hooks, github.release with assets, and pre-release instructions

assertions.text: Config has hooks.before:init with lint and/or test commands
Config has hooks.after:bump with build command
Config has github.release set to true
Config has github.assets with dist/*.zip or similar glob
Output includes pre-release instructions with --preRelease=beta
Improved config preserves original git.commitMessage and npm.publish
The output .release-it.json is valid JSON

evals.prompt: release-it 커스텀 플러그인을 만들어줘. VERSION.txt 파일에서 버전을 읽고 쓰고, 릴리스 후에 Slack webhook으로 알림을 보내는 플러그인이야. npm의 기본 버전 관리는 비활성화해야 해.
evals.expected_output: Custom plugin JS file with getLatestVersion(), bump(), release/afterRelease with Slack webhook, disablePlugin(), and sample config

assertions.text: Plugin class extends Plugin from release-it
Plugin implements getLatestVersion() reading VERSION.txt
Plugin implements bump(version) writing VERSION.txt
Plugin implements Slack webhook POST in release() or afterRelease()
Plugin has static disablePlugin() returning 'npm' or config uses npm: false
Plugin uses this.step() for interactive prompt/spinner
A sample .release-it.json config showing plugin registration exists
Plugin uses ESM syntax (import/export)

evals.prompt: 단일 서비스 앱의 release-it 대화형 릴리스를 설정해줘. pnpm release를 사용하고 모든 질문은 @inquirer/prompts로 보여줘. package.json 버전은 1.2.3이고 npm 배포와 GitHub Release는 필요 없어. 버전 선택 후 commit, tag, push를 각각 확인하고 바로 실행하게 해줘. 아니요 또는 취소이면 그 작업과 나머지를 멈추고 남은 상태를 안내해줘. 실행 가능한 스크립트와 설정을 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Copyable project entry script and Inquirer prompt adapter with version as the first question, exact version propagated to release-it, ordered Git task callbacks, and whole-flow stop/state reporting.

assertions.text: The first runtime question is version selection, without an app picker or start confirmation.
The version menu displays current 1.2.3 and concrete next versions and waits for a submitted choice.

All release questions use Inquirer, with native y/n confirmations and default: true for commit, tag, and push; release-it receives the selected version and a compatible register/show prompt adapter through its second API argument.
Commit confirmation is followed by its awaited task before tag confirmation/task and then push confirmation/task.

Explicit No and Ctrl+C at each Git confirmation stop that task and all later steps, while Enter approves it; prompt ExitPromptError/AbortPromptError are handled as cancellation without swallowing other errors.
States the chosen recovery policy, reports actual file/index/HEAD/tag/push state, and does not promise complete restoration solely because HEAD is unchanged.
Built-in git.push remains enabled; no hook or wrapper executes a replacement push, publication, or deployment.

evals.prompt: pnpm 모노레포에 release-it 대화형 릴리스를 설정해줘. 서비스 앱은 apps/api (1.2.3)와 apps/web (4.5.6), 공유 라이브러리는 packages/ui (0.8.0)이야. pnpm release로 서비스 앱 하나를 선택하고 버전을 고른 후 commit, tag, push를 각각 확인해 실행하려고 해. 질문은 전부 @inquirer/prompts로 만들어줘. 선택한 앱의 package.json과 CHANGELOG.md, api-v 또는 web-v 태그를 사용하고 npm 배포는 하지 않아. 실행 가능한 스크립트와 설정을 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Single-select service manifest and root command that change cwd to the selected app, bind that app version/changelog/tag configuration, then reuse the interactive Git flow.

assertions.text: The first runtime question selects exactly one service app; API and Web are offered but packages/ui and root tooling are excluded.
Changing the app config path is accompanied by the correct app cwd for version reads and release-it execution.
Choosing Web reads 4.5.6 and propagates its selected exact version to the actual version update, not root or API.
The selected app CHANGELOG.md is written and both recommendation and changelog history scopes exclude the other app.
Tag name/match and changelog tag prefix agree for each app; does not claim follow-tags transfers only the selected tag.
Does not recursively release workspaces, disable selected-app Git, publish npm packages, or use direct push hooks.
Accounts for the repository-wide index consumed by commit and verifies no sibling app version or changelog writes.

evals.prompt: 서비스 앱의 pnpm release 대화형 진입 스크립트를 만들어줘. 모든 질문은 @inquirer/prompts를 쓰고 실제 작업은 release-it이 수행해야 해. 기존 설정은 ci:true, only-version:true, increment:minor, preRelease:beta이고 conventional-changelog는 major를 추천하는 상태야. 현재 버전 1.2.3에서 내가 선택한 patch 1.2.4가 적용되어야 하고, CI=true 또는 GITHUB_ACTIONS=true가 있어도 실제 터미널에서는 버전과 commit/tag/push 질문을 생략하면 안 돼. 터미널 없는 입력은 작업 전에 종료해줘. 각 단계 거절과 취소 동작을 검증할 수 있는 예제도 포함해줘.
evals.expected_output: Explicit version selection and safe mode precedence despite inherited options/recommendations/CI, early non-TTY stop, source-version compatibility notes, and isolated verification instructions without production effects.

assertions.text: Explicitly overrides CI, only-version, release-version, changelog, snapshot and other version-affecting settings in the API call rather than relying only on environment edits.
Inquirer asks for the version before release-it; selected exact 1.2.4 beats the configured minor/beta and recommended major.
Checks that resolved current/next version matches the displayed choice before version/changelog writes when plugins can override resolution.
Checks both stdin and stdout TTYs and exits before config hooks or writes; does not pipe answers or fall back to CI.
The default command rejects CLI flags or automatic-answer mechanisms that could bypass the required choices.
Records a checked release-it version and the register/show injection contract, with version-specific compatibility checks.

Verification covers No/cancel and Enter approval at commit/tag/push, CI env and redirected I/O in isolated terminals. Pushes are recorded or sent only to a disposable local bare remote, and no production publication or deployment runs.

evals.prompt: release-it 21.0.1의 프로그램 방식 대화형 명령을 다른 버전 공급자에 맞춰줘. package.json은 Node 도구 설치용이고 버전 9.9.9야. 실제 제품 버전은 VERSION의 2.3.4이며 기존 커스텀 플러그인이 VERSION과 저장소 루트의 release-manifest.json을 갱신해. npm 배포는 없어. 기존 취소 정책은 변경을 남기고 상태를 보여주는 방식이야. 두 파일이 실제 릴리스 커밋에 포함되게 하고, 버전 선택과 최종 상태 보고도 제품 버전을 사용하게 해줘. Git 확인 기본값은 모두 Yes야.
evals.expected_output: Provider-aware adaptation that preserves the existing recovery policy, reads and reports the product version, prevents unrelated npm version writes, and traces both outputs into the commit.

assertions.text: Current version, candidate generation, resolved-version checks, writes, and reporting consistently use VERSION, not the tooling package version.
Disables conflicting npm version writes and accounts for both VERSION and the shared release-manifest.json in staging without claiming cwd alone includes them.
Preserves the requested remaining-state policy and distinguishes already completed commit/tag/push operations from interrupted preparation.
All three Git confirmations default to true, while No or cancellation still stops the remaining flow.

evals.prompt: 기존 CI는 release-it --ci를 실행하며 npm.publish:false, github.release:true야. requireCleanWorkingDir를 false로 바꿀 때의 영향을 설명하고 실패 후 남은 상태를 진단하는 방법을 개선해줘. 현재 CLI 실행 방식과 릴리스 대상을 유지해줘. 대화형 감싸기 스크립트로 전환할 필요는 없어.
evals.expected_output: A focused CLI/CI diagnosis preserving the existing entry point and release capabilities, with version-scoped local/remote recovery behavior and accurate state inspection.

assertions.text: Keeps the CLI/CI entry point and requested hosted release; does not add Inquirer scripts, force ci:false, or enable npm publishing.
Explains both the clean-check and local rollback-registration effect, distinguishes push-error remote cleanup, and does not equate local unchanged HEAD with no external effects.
Inspects tracked/index state, relevant version outputs, commits, tags, and remote action results without automatically discarding pre-existing work.

evals.prompt: release-it 21.0.1용 커스텀 플러그인을 작성해줘. manifest.json에서 제품 버전을 읽고 갱신하며 npm 플러그인은 비활성화해. 릴리스 단계에서 confirm 질문을 등록해 사용자 승인 시에만 알림 함수를 호출해. 질문 기본값은 true이고 알림 함수는 의존성으로 교체 가능해야 해. dry-run에서는 파일 쓰기와 알림 호출이 없어야 해. 외부 플러그인 A, B를 이 순서로 등록했을 때 실행 순서도 설명해줘.
evals.expected_output: A compatible version-provider plugin with named prompt definitions, guarded direct effects, and correct lifecycle group ordering, verified using a local notification stub.

assertions.text: Registers a prompt-name map with a function-valued message and default:true, and invokes it through this.step using the matching key.
Dry-run leaves the manifest unchanged and does not call the notification function; this.step alone is not assumed to prevent direct effects.
Preserves A then B within the external group, placing that group before core plugins through beforeRelease and after core plugins for release/afterRelease.
Disables the npm plugin and connects the selected version to the actual manifest update, without sending a real external notification during verification.
